title: Record Envelope (v1) — Universal wrapper for all Record instances
description: Phase 16 — The Record envelope wraps plane-specific payloads. Envelope keys (canonical_version, captured_at, occurred_at, extractor_version, plane, record_type, source_key, stable_id, upstream_id, raw_ref, payload, data_class, idempotency_key, trace_context, field_provenance, tombstone, retracted_at, signature, signature_alg, signing_key_id, region, league_id, league_bucket) are major-bumped together. Plane payloads version independently. Reserved fields ship with sane defaults so adding them later is not a schema bump. JSONSchema ensures envelope conforms before emitter writes.

canonical_version.description: Bumped when alias / timezone rule changes occur.

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC envelope clock when the record was processed by the extractor.

data_class.description: Data classification: public (default), internal (team-only), restricted (compliance), pii (privacy-sensitive). Per Phase 11, emitter refuses to mix restricted/pii records into a partition not declared at that class.

extractor_version.description: Semantic version identifier of the extractor that produced this record, e.g. 'mackolik.score@3'.

field_provenance.description: Per-field source attribution: {field_name → {source_id, observed_at}}. Optional; per Phase 13.36, required for schedule, score, lineup, market planes for proofreader conflict resolution and patcher diagnostics.

idempotency_key.description: Unique identifier for deduplication at the consumer. Format: (record_type, stable_id, captured_at) tuple in canonical form.

league_bucket.description: Optional league sub-partition for multi-tenant isolation (Phase 13). Null for non-league records.

league_id.description: ISO-3166 league identifier when applicable, e.g. 'tr_super_lig'. Null for non-league records.

occurred_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC event-time when the source dates the event. Null if the source does not provide an event timestamp.

payload.description: Plane-specific record content, validated against common/schemas/feeds/<plane>.v*.json.

plane.description: Logical plane this record belongs to (determines payload schema, retention, and consumer).

raw_ref.description: Path into the snapshot store (e.g. S3 or filesystem) for byte-exact replay of the original source document.

region.description: Data residency region per Phase 13.24. Determines shard prefix (feeds/region=<r>/...). Null for non-regional records.

retracted_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC when this record was retracted by a freshness.events.v1 event. Null if not retracted.

signature.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 signature proving the emitter wrote this record. Reserved for Phase 17 scraper-patcher PR-auto-merge story; not yet implemented.

signature_alg.description: Signature algorithm identifier when signature is present. Null if signature is null. Reserved for Phase 17.

signing_key_id.description: Key identifier used to sign this record. Null if signature is null. Key material is managed out-of-band (Phase 17). Reserved for Phase 17.

source_key.description: The data source that produced this record.

stable_id.description: Canonical identity key for joins and deduplication. Computed per CONTENT_FRESHNESS §2; immutable once minted.

tombstone.description: True if this record is a tombstone (deletion marker) from freshness.events.v1. Snapshot builder honors tombstones at watermark-close time.

trace_context.description: Optional W3C Trace Context (Phase 16 ledger #31) for distributed tracing. When present, contains traceparent and optional tracestate per W3C Trace Context standard (https://www.w3.org/TR/trace-context/). Null if not provided. Preserved end-to-end (extractor → writer → reader → consumer).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent: version-trace_id-parent_id-trace_flags (https://www.w3.org/TR/trace-context/#traceparent-header-field-values). Never reconstructed; always passed through from extractor.

tracestate.description: Optional W3C Trace Context tracestate: vendor-specific trace state. Preserved as-is when present.

truncated_at_bytes.description: Byte offset where the payload was truncated due to exceeding cfg.emitter_max_payload_bytes. Null if not truncated. When set, a proof.flag{kind=record_oversize} is raised on the bus.

upstream_id.description: The source-native ID when available, e.g. fixture ID from mackolik.com. Null if the source does not provide an ID.
